summary:
Revised MVP Execution Plan incorporating the new Forge Spirit Mascot & Brand System across the entire product experience:
1. New Forge Mascot & Brand Identity System: Replace the old mascot everywhere with the new hooded Forge Spirit (violet-and-navy cloak, glowing flame tuft, glowing violet Forge Crystal, gold accents, and backpack) with all 6 signature expressions (Happy, Thinking, Excited, Coding, Cheering, Winking) plus the 4-point Forge Star & Crystal brand mark and app icon.
2. Interactive Lesson Studio with Forge Buddy: Forge explains tricky concepts, tells jokes, highlights interview traps (like async/await), powers the Studio Audio Narration bar, and celebrates when learners get answers right or run code in the in-lesson live sandbox.
3. Reactive Playground & Zero-Setup Project Builder: Forge reacts in real time when code runs, points out errors when bugs occur, and celebrates completed project checklist milestones inside the pre-loaded project workspace.
4. Mock Interview Simulator with Friendly Forge Coach: Elevate Interview Prep to the top navbar, redesign in the Atelier + Violet/Navy Forge palette, add live code execution, and feature Forge as a supportive sideline coach offering progressive hints without spoiling answers.
5. Site-Wide Mascot Presence: Empty states, loading moments, onboarding, progress milestones, and achievements all feature consistent Forge illustrations and expressions.
